stockReconstruction.model: v19 daily raw score / independent trade filters

methodology.variants: Predeclared legacy percentile20, corrected raw VIX20, and fixed K5. No threshold optimization or best-result selection.
methodology.scoreTarget: Completed-source-close to next one and three closes, blended 0.55/0.45. Score is not a probability.
methodology.tradeTarget: Next completed SPY open-to-close, separate permission with fixed 10bp round-trip costs per active day.
methodology.causal: Past-only trailing percentiles and regime calibration; only matured three-session labels; five-calendar-day neighbor exclusion.
caveats: Reconstruction from current stored prices, not point-in-time-vintage or live performance. Available warmup differs from original ten-year jobs.

Overlapping three-session outcomes are dependent. Direction hit intervals are descriptive Wilson intervals; no independence or significance claim.

cryptoReconstruction.methodology: Actual crypto engine on a causal reconstruction: trailing ranks, past regimes and only matured three-day labels. Shared closes carried forward only from earlier dates. No parameter search. Score labels and trade permissions remain separate.
limitations: Current stored prices and historical warmup differ from each original live job; not point-in-time-vintage replay.
Historical periods were previously reviewed; no untouched holdout or predictive-edge claim.
Crypto briefings publish after the source UTC close. Source-close-to-close outcomes measure historical association, not achievable live returns; do not call these trading profits.
